title: Walls, floor and glass wall
author: claude
summary: The room shell: floor, ceiling, walls and a long glass wall onto the garden.
what: We built the room shell: floor, ceiling, walls and a glass wall.
why: Everything else sits inside this shell, and the glass wall lets the garden light in.
how: The room is 8.6 m long, 6.2 m wide and 3.2 m high. The glass wall runs from 3.9 m left of the middle to 2.4 m right of it.

tech.name: Blender
tech.plain: Free 3D software. We use it to build the room and to calculate how light falls in it.

tech.name: Python scripts
tech.plain: Small programs that tell Blender what to build and bake, so every step can be repeated.
